hook.name: UnimonHook
hook.description: Mints ERC-721 Unimon NFTs to swappers proportional to native currency input (1 NFT per 0.00000111 ETH), restricted to verified routers and native-currency-as-input swaps. Liquidity addition is restricted to a single event. NFTs can be hatched post-mint by burning a companion ERC-20 energy token to assign a pseudo-random level.
